notes: training volume: v2_60d_csz and w40_full2epoch share the 100-step loss rows up to step 9000, so the matched-step losses isolate the two-epoch continuation that only w40_full2epoch has
capacity: v2_60d_csz, w80_9000 and w160_9000 share the same 9000-step schedule, so their matched-step losses and step-9000 validation metrics compare widths at equal update budget
v2_60d_csz trained with logging.learning_curves=false, so it has no learning_curve.json checkpoints; its curve is the 100-step events.jsonl loss rows and its single end-of-run validation

curves.validation_split_note: the learning-curve checkpoints and the end-of-run validation numbers score the V2 validation split 2023-11-01..2023-11-14 (10 days, 80 sections, 79,920 samples); they are within-training diagnostics, not the three development windows

metric_scope: local approximate jinyiquant.evaluation (gross forward label returns, no fees, slippage or execution); not the official platform score

bootstrap.method: moving consecutive-day block bootstrap of the paired daily delta series, estimator scripts/replay_model_versions.py::_block_delta

plan.pooled_metrics_rule: equal weight per paired trading day across the three windows; not sample-weighted
plan.pooled_series_rule: the three windows' paired daily deltas concatenated in chronological order and weighted equally per paired trading day; gate means are computed on this pooled series

training_continuity.note: the two-epoch arm's first 9000 updates reproduce the reused reference run's 100-step loss rows; its extra epochs are a continuation of the same trajectory, not a second independent sample
